##### Project general facts

Amethyst by Siroya is a contemporary residential project. Inspired by the calming essence of its namesake gemstone, the development blends modern architecture with natural elegance. Framed by landscaped greenery and soft design elements, Amethyst offers a tranquil yet vibrant lifestyle for residents seeking serenity without compromising on accessibility, making it a perfect choice for those looking for a buy-to-invest property.

Residents enjoy a range of lifestyle-focused amenities that elevate daily living, including a rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views, a dedicated children's pool, a fully equipped gym, an outdoor cinema, and inviting lounge and BBQ areas. With a welcoming lobby, rooftop terrace, and wellness facilities designed for both relaxation and activity, Amethyst offers a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and community living where every element is crafted to nurture well-being.

Every residence at Amethyst is thoughtfully designed to combine aesthetic warmth with functional comfort. Interiors feature premium materials such as marble textures and warm wood tones, while large balconies and expansive windows invite natural light into every living space. Kitchens are fully equipped, and the homes are crafted to allow personalization while maintaining timeless elegance — ideal for both individuals and families looking for a peaceful sanctuary within the city.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Majan, a district located at the heart of the large Dubailand community, this exceptional location is a perfect place for those looking for a buy-to-invest property. With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road, providing strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah, and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises residential complexes, iconic towers, hotels, and mixed-use units.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price, making it an attractive option for investors.

For those seeking a residence that embodies contemporary elegance, community connection, and strategic connectivity, Majan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of affordability, accessibility, and a forward-thinking community makes it one of Dubai's most promising destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living
